sql.ahj.utility.list.all: SELECT au.id, au.name, au.metro_area_id, ma.metro_area, s.id as state_id, s.abbreviation as state, au.active FROM brs.ahj_utility au LEFT JOIN brs.metro_area ma ON ma.id = au.metro_area_id LEFT JOIN brs.sales_area sa ON sa.id = ma.sales_area_id LEFT JOIN flow.state s ON s.id = sa.state_id ORDER BY au.name
